# National Audubon Society

> National Audubon Society is a leading conservation organization dedicated to protecting birds and their habitats globally through science-based advocacy, habitat restoration, and climate solutions.

Audubon combines scientific research, policy advocacy, and on-the-ground conservation work across diverse ecosystems—from coastal and wetland habitats to urban environments and forests. The organization operates across the Americas with a strategic focus on migratory bird protection, climate resilience, and biodiversity preservation.

## Core Conservation Strategy

- [National Audubon Society](https://www.audubon.org): National Audubon Society homepage: protecting birds and habitats globally.
- [Welcome to Flight Plan](https://www.audubon.org/about/welcome-flight-plan): Audubon's Flight Plan: 2023-2028 strategic plan for conservation impact.
- [Why Birds?](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/why-birds): Educational guide explaining why bird conservation matters for ecosystems.

## Habitat Conservation Programs

- [Coasts and Oceans](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/coasts-and-oceans): Audubon's coastal conservation strategy protecting seabirds and marine habitats.
- [Rivers, Lakes, and Wetlands](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/rivers-lakes-wetlands): Audubon's water conservation initiatives for wetlands, rivers, and lakes.
- [Grasslands, Aridlands, and Forests](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/prairies-and-forests): Grassland and forest habitat conservation on public and private lands.
- [Cities, Towns, and Parks](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/cities-and-towns): Urban bird conservation through native plants and bird-safe buildings.
- [Important Bird Areas](https://www.audubon.org/important-bird-areas): Important Bird Areas program identifying critical habitats across America.

## Climate & Science Initiatives

- [Our Climate Strategy](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/climate): Audubon's climate strategy linking renewable energy to bird protection.
- [Birds and Clean Energy](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/climate/clean-energy): Guide to responsibly sited clean energy protecting birds from climate change.
- [Natural Climate Solutions](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/climate/natural-climate-solutions): Ecosystem restoration strategies for climate change and biodiversity protection.
- [Restoration and Resiliency](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/climate/restoration-resiliency): Habitat restoration from coasts to prairies for climate resilience.
- [Climate Science](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/climate/science): Audubon's climate science research and conservation products for policy.
- [Audubon Science](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/science): Audubon's science initiatives for migratory birds and climate research.
- [Migratory Bird Initiative](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/science/bird-migration-initiative): Science-based Migratory Bird Initiative protecting birds across hemispheres.

## Advocacy & Policy

- [Audubon & Action](https://www.audubon.org/advocacy): Audubon's advocacy and policy efforts for bird conservation legislation.

## Hemispheric Conservation

- [Audubon Latin America and Caribbean](https://www.audubon.org/our-work/americas): Audubon's hemispheric bird conservation strategy across Americas regions.

## News & Publications

- [Discover Audubon Magazine](https://www.audubon.org/audubonmagazine): Audubon Magazine: latest news on birds, conservation, and nature photography.
- [News](https://www.audubon.org/news): Audubon news on conservation, policy advocacy, and habitat protection.
- [Press Room](https://www.audubon.org/menu/press-room): Audubon press room with news releases and media contact information.
